requirements.requirement: The system must define a credential completeness schema that includes fields for degrees, licenses, taxonomy codes, and a computed completeness score.
The system must represent completeness score as a normalized numeric value within a fixed range (either 0–1 or 0–100) defined in the contract.
The system must define explicit weights for degrees, licenses, and taxonomy codes that sum to 1.0 (or 100%).
The system must map NPI response fields from provider_detail_service.py to the schema fields without loss of required credential information.
The system must define normalization rules that treat fully populated fields as complete and assign maximum weight contribution.
The system must define normalization rules that assign partial credit when credential fields are present but incomplete (e.g., partial taxonomy entries).
The system must define normalization rules that assign zero contribution when credential fields are missing or null.
The system must support multiple entries for taxonomy codes and aggregate them into a single completeness contribution.
The system must support multiple licenses and treat presence of at least one valid license as contributing positively to completeness.
The system must define a deterministic scoring contract such that identical input data always yields the same completeness score.
The system must output a structured scoring contract that includes total score and per-component contributions (degrees, licenses, taxonomy).
The system must define handling logic for empty taxonomy arrays in NPI responses and treat them as missing data.
The system must define handling logic for missing credential (degree) fields in NPI responses without causing schema validation failure.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable to JSON for downstream consumption by scoring logic and APIs.
The system must validate that all required schema fields are present before scoring contract execution.
The system must define an exception rule for malformed NPI input where credential fields are not in expected structure and default score to 0.
The system must define an exception rule for entirely missing NPI data where no credential fields are available and return a completeness score of 0 with empty components.
The system must ensure that weighting and normalization rules are explicitly documented in the scoring contract output.
